name: classify_cpc
description:
Work with CPC (Cooperative Patent Classification) codes — search, look up, or map them.

Routes by ``mode``: 'search' finds candidate symbols by keyword (returns a
ranked list); 'lookup' returns one symbol's official title and hierarchy;
'map' cross-references one symbol between CPC, IPC, and the US
Classification System. Find a symbol with mode='search' first, then
mode='lookup' to read it or mode='map' to translate it.

Related tools: get_fees.

mode.description: What to do. 'search' = find candidate CPC symbols by keyword. 'lookup' = get the title/definition for one symbol you already have. 'map' = cross-reference one symbol between schemes (CPC/IPC/USCLS).

query.description: mode='search': keyword(s) describing the technology area (e.g. 'machine learning', 'lithium battery thermal management').

full.description: mode='search': False (default) = lean stub per hit (symbol + title + parent). True = full upstream record (match percentage, title parts).

name: copyright
description:
Search U.S. Copyright Office registrations and recorded documents, or fetch one by id.

Routes by ``mode``: 'search' finds registrations and recorded documents
(transfers, assignments, licenses) by keyword and returns lean stubs;
'get' fetches the full record(s) for a Public Records id. Both return a
``ListEnvelope``. Search first, then pass a hit's ``public_records_id`` to
mode='get'.

Related tools: classify_cpc, get_fees.

mode.description: What to do. 'search' = find U.S. Copyright Office registrations by keyword. 'get' = fetch one or more full records by Public Records id.

query.description: mode='search': a title, a claimant/author name, a registration number (e.g. 'TX 1234567'), or any keyword.

public_records_id.description: mode='get': the opaque Public Records id from a search hit's ``public_records_id`` field (NOT a registration number). Single id or a list for portfolio workflows. Examples: 'voyager_12345'.

field.description: mode='search': which field to search — 'keyword' (default, all fields), 'title', or 'name' (claimant/author).

full.description: mode='search': False (default) = lean stub per hit. True = full upstream record (every title/claimant/date/class, relevance score).

name: download_document
description:
Download a patent, court, PTAB, USITC, or bulk-register document by source.

Routes by ``source`` to the matching downloader. Return shape is uniform
across sources: single-file sources (patent_pdf, cafc, usitc_attachment,
ipa_bulk) return one ``ResourceLink`` / signed-URL record; bulk sources
(the ptab_* and usitc_investigation) return ``ResourceLink``s plus a zip
manifest. ptab_trial caps at 50/decisions and 100/documents; usitc caps at
25 attachments — narrow with item_ids / document_types / date range.

Related tools: search_bulk_data, search_ptab, search_cafc_opinions,
get_patent.

source.description: Which document repository to download from. 'patent_pdf' = a patent/publication PDF (USPTO PPUBS → EPO OPS cascade). 'cafc' = a Federal Circuit opinion PDF. 'ptab_appeal'/'ptab_interference' = PTAB ex parte appeal / pre-AIA interference decisions. 'ptab_trial' = AIA trial board decisions; 'ptab_trial_docs' = AIA trial party filings. 'ipa_bulk' = resolve an IP Australia IP RAPID release to its URL.

identifier.description: Primary key for the source. patent_pdf → patent/publication number ('US10123456B2'); cafc → appeal number ('2023-1234'); ptab_trial/ptab_trial_docs → AIA trial number ('IPR2024-00001'); ptab_appeal → application number ('16123456'); ptab_interference → interference number; ipa_bulk → CKAN release id (from search_bulk_data mode='ipa_releases').

dataset_id.description: ipa_bulk only: parent CKAN dataset id (defaults to 'iprapid').

item_ids.description: ptab_* and usitc_investigation: specific document identifiers to fetch. None = all matching the other filters.

document_types.description: usitc_investigation only: filter to these EDIS document types (e.g. ['Motion', 'Order']). Must match exactly.

after.description: ptab_* and usitc_investigation: only docs on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

before.description: ptab_* and usitc_investigation: only docs on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_epo
description:
Fetch one structured EPO OPS or European Patent Register view.

Family intelligence and unitary status take one publication number; the
other views also accept lists. Find identifiers with ``search_epo``;
convert number formats with ``resolve_patent_number``.

Related tools: search_epo, resolve_patent_number.

view.description: Which EPO record to fetch for the patent. 'biblio' = bibliographic data (title, applicants, inventors, IPC/CPC, priority). 'family' = INPADOC family members (priority-linked publications across jurisdictions). 'family_intelligence' = source-separated family, backward-citation, legal-event, and EP Register evidence for one publication, without a family-wide legal-status conclusion. 'fulltext' = claims + description. 'legal_events' = legal-status timeline (filing, publication, grant, lapse). 'citations' = structured backward patent and non-patent citations. 'equivalents' = simple-family equivalent publications. 'register_biblio' = correction-aware European Patent Register bibliographic data for one or more EP publications. 'register_events' = European Patent Register dossier events. 'procedural_steps' = European Patent Register dossier chronology. 'unitary_status' = EPO Register Unitary Patent (UP) record (single EP number only).

identifier.description: Patent document number, or a list for portfolio workflows. Examples: 'EP1234567A1', ['EP1234567A1', 'US10123456B2']. EPO OPS accepts country-prefixed publication numbers across all jurisdictions it indexes. NOTE: views 'family_intelligence' and 'unitary_status' take a single publication number. Pass the granted B1 when known for unitary_status.

name: get_fees
description:
Get patent, trademark, and design fees from the USPTO, EPO, and EUIPO.

Routes by ``mode``: 'schedule' returns one office's full published fee
schedule; 'lookup' filters a schedule down to line items matching a
category/tier/year; 'jurisdictions' lists every available (office, right)
schedule so you know what to ask for. Discover with mode='jurisdictions'
first, then mode='schedule' or mode='lookup'.

Related tools: classify_cpc.

mode.description: What to do. 'schedule' = the full published fee schedule for one office. 'lookup' = filter a schedule down to matching line items. 'jurisdictions' = list which (office, right) schedules are available.

jurisdiction.description: mode='schedule'/'lookup': office or jurisdiction — 'USPTO', 'US', 'EPO', 'EUIPO', or 'EP'. Not used for mode='jurisdictions'.

right.description: mode='schedule'/'lookup': which IP right's schedule — 'patent' (default), 'trademark', or 'design'.

category.description: mode='lookup': filter to one fee category ('filing', 'search', 'examination', 'grant', 'renewal', 'maintenance', 'excess_claims', 'extension', 'appeal', 'petition', 'opposition'). None = every category.

tier.description: mode='lookup': entity-tier filter for offices with discounts (USPTO patents + designs). 'large' (default), 'small', or 'micro'. Ignored on schedules with no tier dimension.

year.description: mode='lookup': required when filtering renewal/maintenance fees (USPTO maintenance: 4, 8, 12; EPO renewals: 2-20; EUIPO design renewals: 5, 10, 15, 20; TM renewals: 10). None excludes renewal/maintenance rows.

refresh.description: Force USPTO source revalidation for schedule/lookup.

name: get_file_history
description:
Work with a USPTO application's prosecution file history — list, read one, or bulk-download.

Return shape varies by mode. 'list' returns a ``ListEnvelope`` of document
descriptors. 'item' returns one signed PDF, XML, or DOCX download.
'download' returns ``ResourceLink``s plus a zip manifest. Discover document
ids, codes, and available formats with mode='list' first.

Related tools: search_uspto, get_uspto.

mode.description: 'list' (default) = enumerate file-history documents with codes and dates. 'item' = download one document in an exact format (needs document_identifier). 'download' = bulk-download matching PDFs.

document_identifier.description: Required when mode='item'. A document_identifier from mode='list'.

format.description: mode='item' artifact format: 'pdf' (default), 'xml', or 'docx'. The item is returned without OCR or text extraction.

item_ids.description: mode='download': specific document_identifier values. None = all documents matching the other filters.

document_codes.description: mode='download': filter to USPTO document codes (e.g. ['CTNF', 'NOA']).

after.description: mode='download': include docs on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

before.description: mode='download': include docs on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_legal_reference
description:
Fetch the full text of one legal-reference section by identifier.

Always returns a ``ListEnvelope`` (stable shape). Route by ``corpus``;
the identifier is a section number for examination manuals/guidelines or
a statute citation for statute corpora — discover it with
``search_legal_reference``. For corpus='upc' or 'wipo_lex' use
``get_upc_section`` / ``get_wipo_lex_legislation`` instead.

Related tools: search_legal_reference, get_upc_section, get_wipo_lex_legislation.

corpus.description: Which legal-reference corpus the identifier belongs to (same enum as search_legal_reference). US: 'uspto_mpep', 'uspto_tmep'. EPO: 'epo_guidelines', 'epo_pct_guidelines', 'epo_up_guidelines', 'epo_case_law', 'epc'. National: 'dpma', 'ukipo_mopp', 'india_statutes', 'india_mppp', 'tw_trade_secrets'. For 'upc' or 'wipo_lex' use get_upc_section / get_wipo_lex_legislation — their identifiers (instrument key / legislation id) differ.

identifier.description: Section number or statute citation, from a search_legal_reference hit. Examples: '2106' (MPEP), 'Article 54' (EPC), '§ 4 PatG' (dpma), 'Section 3 Patents Act' (india_statutes).

version.description: MPEP installed release selector; other corpora support current only.

name: get_litigation
description:
Fetch one tribunal record by identifier — a PTAB record, USITC investigation, or UPC decision.

Always returns a ``ListEnvelope`` (stable shape whether you pass one id
or many). Find identifiers with ``search_litigation`` (PTAB/CAFC) or the
structured-filter search ``search_upc_decisions``. For child records of a
PTAB trial use ``list_ptab_children``.

Related tools: search_litigation, list_ptab_children, search_upc_decisions.

forum.description: Which tribunal the identifier names. 'ptab' = USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board record. 'upc' = Unified Patent Court decision.

identifier.description: The record identifier, or a list for portfolio workflows. By forum: ptab → trial number (e.g. 'IPR2024-00001') or a document identifier for non-proceeding ptab_type; upc → canonical case id (e.g. 'UPC_CFI_1747/2025', 'UPC_CoA_335/2023').

ptab_type.description: forum='ptab' only: what the identifier names. 'proceeding' takes a trial number; the others take a document identifier from search_litigation(forum='ptab').

name: get_patent
title: Get Patent (biblio / claims / family / figures / citations)
description:
Fetch one slice of a patent by view, using clean public sources only.

Routes by ``view`` and (for biblio) by jurisdiction: US → PPUBS, KR →
KIPRIS (when configured), other → EPO OPS. No Google Patents is touched.

Find numbers with ``search_patents``; normalize with
``resolve_patent_number``.

Related tools: search_patents, resolve_patent_number.

view.description: Which slice of a patent to fetch. 'biblio' = bibliographic record (title, abstract, applicants, classifications, dates) — US via PPUBS, KR via KIPRIS, everything else via EPO OPS. 'claims' = structured claims (US ODP grant XML, EPO OPS full-text fallback). 'family' = patent family relationships via USPTO ODP. 'figures' = figure page images (PPUBS/EPO; callout bounding boxes are not available from clean sources). 'citations' = US examiner-cited prior-art references (true forward citations have no clean public source; non-US unavailable).

identifier.description: Patent or publication number with country and kind code. Examples: 'US10123456B2', 'US20230012345A1', 'EP3456789A1', 'KR1020230012345'. view='biblio' accepts a list for portfolio fan-out; the other views take a single number.

name: get_trademark
description:
Fetch one or more USPTO trademarks by serial or registration number.

Always returns a ``ListEnvelope`` (stable shape for one id or many). For
the full register record use view='record' (TESS); for current status,
prosecution documents, or last-update timestamps use the TSDR views
(status/documents/last_update). Find identifiers with ``search_trademarks``.

Related tools: search_trademarks, search_trademark_assignments.

identifier.description: USPTO trademark serial number (8 digits, e.g. '97123456') or registration number (6-7 digits, e.g. '1234567'). Pass a list for portfolio workflows; the response shape stays a ListEnvelope. view='documents' accepts a single serial number only.

view.description: Which facet to fetch. 'record' (default) = full TESS register record (wordmark, owner, goods/services, dates). 'status' = current TSDR status. 'documents' = TSDR prosecution documents (single serial). 'last_update' = TSDR last-modified timestamp.

name: get_upc_section
description:
Fetch the full plain text of one or more Unified Patent Court (UPC) legal instruments.

Note: section-level (per-Article, per-Rule) retrieval is not yet
available — this returns the entire instrument text. Pair with
``search_upc_statutes`` to locate a specific provision and quote the
snippet. Accepts either a single instrument key or a list (§5.4); the
response is always a ListEnvelope so the shape is stable. Bounded
concurrent fan-out internally; order matches the input.

Related tools: search_upc_statutes, list_upc_instruments.

instrument.description: Instrument key, or a list for portfolio reads. One of 'upca', 'rop', 'fees', 'coc' (or 'statute' as an alias for the UPCA Annex I portion). Examples: 'upca', ['upca', 'rop'].

name: get_uspto
description:
Fetch one USPTO record by identifier — application, publication, petition, office action, or assignment.

Always returns a ``ListEnvelope`` (stable shape whether you pass one id
or many). For status/dates use dataset='application'; for claim/spec
text use dataset='publication'. Find identifiers with ``search_uspto``
(or ``search_office_actions`` / ``search_patent_assignments``).

Related tools: search_uspto, get_file_history.

dataset.description: What kind of record the identifier names. 'application' = ODP application metadata. 'publication' = PPUBS patent text. 'petition' = petition decision record. 'office_action' = office-action document. 'assignment' = recorded assignments for an application.

identifier.description: The record identifier, or a list for portfolio workflows. By dataset: application/assignment → application number (8+ digits, e.g. '16123456'); publication → publication or patent number (e.g. 'US20230012345A1', 'US10123456B2'); petition → petition record id (from search); office_action → office-action document id (from search_office_actions).

name: get_wipo_lex_legislation
description:
Get one or more WIPO Lex (global IP legislation database) entries by ID.

Returns title, jurisdiction, summary line (year, assent date, type,
subjects), canonical URL, and the list of downloadable PDF/DOC
attachments per entry. Accepts either a single ID or a list (§5.4);
the response is always a ListEnvelope so the shape is stable.
Bounded concurrent fan-out internally; order matches the input.

Related tools: search_wipo_lex_legislation.

legislation_id.description: WIPO Lex internal ID, or a list of IDs for portfolio workflows. Examples: '23293' (Canadian Patent Act), ['23293', '23437'].

name: list_ptab_children
description:
List Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) children — decisions or documents attached to a parent record.

The parent can be an AIA trial number, a USPTO application number (for
ex parte appeals), or a pre-AIA interference number. For trials, pass
``include='both'`` to enumerate decisions and party filings in one
call. Use the document identifiers to fetch full records via
``get_ptab`` or PDFs via the ``download_ptab_*`` family.

Related tools: search_ptab, get_ptab, download_ptab_trial_documents,
download_ptab_trial_decisions, download_ptab_appeal_decisions,
download_ptab_interference_decisions.

parent_type.description: What the ``parent_identifier`` refers to. 'trial' — an AIA trial number (e.g. 'IPR2024-00001'); lists decisions and/or documents. 'application' — a USPTO application number; lists ex parte appeal decisions for it. 'interference' — an interference number; lists decisions.

parent_identifier.description: Trial number, application number, or interference number

include.description: For parent_type='trial' only: 'decisions' (default), 'documents', or 'both'. Appeals and interferences only return decisions.

name: patent_client_status
title: Patent Client Status
description:
Report package version and which env-gated connector families are configured.

No network calls — reports the installed ``patent-client-agents`` version
and, per connector family, whether its required environment variables are
present. The USPTO/EPO clean sources and bundled SQLite corpora are the
always-available backbone; KR (KIPRIS) search/retrieval activates only when
``KIPO_KIPRIS_API_KEY`` is configured.

Related tools: search_patents, get_patent.

name: resolve_patent_number
title: Resolve / Convert Patent Number
description:
Normalize or convert a patent number, or show EPO search syntax.

'resolve' confirms a publication number against PPUBS and returns its
canonical form. 'convert_epo' translates between EPO normalization formats.
'cql_help' returns the EPO CQL field codes and operators for building EPO
queries. All three return a §5.9 ``ResponseEnvelope``.

Related tools: search_patents, get_patent.

mode.description: What to do. 'resolve' = normalize a publication number to canonical form and confirm it exists in USPTO Public Search (PPUBS). 'convert_epo' = convert a number between EPO formats (original ↔ docdb ↔ epodoc). 'cql_help' = show the EPO CQL search syntax accepted by EPO search (no identifier needed).

number.description: The number to act on. Required for 'resolve' and 'convert_epo'; ignored for 'cql_help'. resolve: 'US20230012345A1', '10123456', etc. convert_epo: 'EP1234567A1', 'EP.1234567.A1', 'EP1234567'.

name: search_bulk_data
description:
Browse bulk IP data catalogs — USPTO bulk products or IP Australia register releases.

Routes by ``mode``. 'datasets' searches the USPTO bulk product catalog;
'dataset' fetches one product's file listing (each file carries a
ready-to-use download URL when the download proxy is configured — fetch it
directly, no API key needed); 'ipa_releases' enumerates downloadable IP
Australia IP RAPID register snapshots. Resolve a listed release to a
download URL with ``download_document`` (source='ipa_bulk').

Related tools: download_document.

mode.description: Which bulk catalog to hit. 'datasets' = search the USPTO bulk data product catalog by keyword. 'dataset' = fetch one USPTO bulk product's details and file listing by product id. 'ipa_releases' = list IP Australia IP RAPID (Australian bulk register) releases on data.gov.au.

query.description: mode='datasets': keyword query over USPTO bulk product names. Required for that mode; ignored otherwise.

product_id.description: mode='dataset': USPTO bulk data product identifier (from mode='datasets'). Required for that mode; ignored otherwise.

dataset_id.description: mode='ipa_releases': data.gov.au CKAN dataset id. Defaults to 'iprapid' (the weekly snapshot). Ignored for the USPTO modes.

latest_only.description: mode='dataset': return only the most recent file in the product (default False returns the full listing — some products have hundreds). Ignored for the other modes.

name: search_cafc_patent_opinions
description:
Search U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit opinions from patent-relevant origins.

Filters to opinions whose origin is PTO, DCT, ITC, or CFC — the four
paths that bring patent cases to the Federal Circuit. Optional date
range narrows the window; date_to requires date_from, and reversed
bounds are rejected. Origins include non-patent cases as well.
Continue with next_cursor and the same dates; cursors are offsets, not
snapshots. Returns lean stubs by default; pass
``full=True`` for the upstream row shape. Use ``download_cafc_pdf``
with an appeal number to pull a specific opinion PDF.

Related tools: search_cafc_opinions, download_cafc_pdf.

full.description: When False (the default), each hit is a lean stub: appeal number, short case name, release date, origin, document type, precedential status, patent classification, PDF URL. When True, each hit carries the full CAFCOpinion record.

offset.description: Offset into the upstream filtered index

next_cursor.description: Continuation from the previous page; overrides offset and page size

name: search_epo
description:
Search worldwide patents (US, EP, WO, JP, CN, KR, and more) via EPO Open Patent Services.

Returns a ListEnvelope of publication or family hits ranked by EPO's
CQL search service. The lean default surfaces just the identifiers an
agent needs to follow up with ``get_epo_biblio`` (bibliography),
``get_epo_fulltext`` (claims + description), ``get_epo_family``
(INPADOC family), ``get_epo_legal_events`` (status timeline), or
``convert_epo_number`` (format conversion). Pass ``group_by='family'``
to deduplicate across priority-linked publications.

Pagination uses EPO's ``range_begin``/``range_end`` window (1-indexed,
inclusive). When ``total > shown + (range_begin - 1)`` the envelope
sets ``more_available=True`` and returns an opaque ``next_cursor`` —
pass it back unchanged for the next page.

Related tools: get_epo_cql_help, get_epo_biblio, get_epo_fulltext,
get_epo_family, get_epo_legal_events, convert_epo_number.

cql_query.description: CQL (Common Query Language) query string. Common examples: 'ta=CRISPR and pa=Broad Institute' (title/abstract + applicant), 'in=Nakamura and ic=H01L' (inventor + IPC class), 'pn=EP1234567' (publication number lookup). Call ``get_epo_cql_help`` for the full field reference.

query.description: Compatibility alias for cql_query. Use cql_query for new callers.

group_by.description: Result grouping: 'publication' (one row per publication, default) or 'family' (one row per patent family — de-duplicates across jurisdictions).

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's ``next_cursor``. Overrides ``range_begin``/``range_end`` when present.

full.description: When False (default), each hit is a lean stub: publication number, application number, publication date, country, kind, family id. When True, hits carry the full upstream ``SearchResult`` shape. For deep bibliographic data on one publication, prefer ``get_epo_biblio``.

jurisdiction.description: Optional national publication filter. CN searches Chinese publications, DE searches German publications, and KR searches Korean publications. The filter is combined with cql_query and reuses the existing EPO fetch tools.

name: search_legal_reference
description:
Search a legal-reference corpus — statutes, examination manuals, or guidelines.

Routes to one of 12 bundled substantive-law corpora by ``corpus`` and
returns relevance-ranked snippet hits. Find a provision, then call
``get_legal_reference`` with the same ``corpus`` and the hit's
section/citation identifier for the full text. The ``statute`` filter
applies only to corpus='dpma' and 'india_statutes'. For corpus='upc' or
'wipo_lex' use ``search_upc_statutes`` / ``search_wipo_lex_legislation``.

Related tools: get_legal_reference, search_upc_statutes, search_wipo_lex_legislation.

corpus.description: Which legal-reference corpus to search. US: 'uspto_mpep' (patent examiner manual), 'uspto_tmep' (trademark examiner manual). EPO: 'epo_guidelines', 'epo_pct_guidelines', 'epo_up_guidelines' (unitary patent), 'epo_case_law' (Boards of Appeal), 'epc' (the Convention). National statutes/manuals: 'dpma' (Germany), 'ukipo_mopp' (UK), 'india_statutes', 'india_mppp' (India patent practice), 'tw_trade_secrets' (Taiwan). For UPC or WIPO Lex law use the dedicated search_upc_statutes / search_wipo_lex_legislation.

query.description: Search query. Examples: 'subject matter eligibility', 'inventive step', 'restriction requirement'. Default treats terms as a phrase (or all-terms for statute corpora); set syntax to widen.

syntax.description: Query syntax: 'adj' (phrase), 'and' (all terms), 'or' (any term), 'exact'. Per-corpus default differs (manuals='adj', statutes='and').

statute.description: Act filter — corpus='dpma': 'PatG'/'MarkenG'/'GebrMG'/'DesignG'/'UrhG'/'GeschGehG'; corpus='india_statutes': 'Patents Act'/'Patent Rules'/'Designs Act'/'Trade Marks Act'/'Copyright Act'. Ignored for other corpora. Omit to search across all Acts.

full.description: False (default) = lean stub per hit. True = full upstream row.

version.description: MPEP installed release selector; other corpora support current only.

name: search_litigation
description:
Search a patent tribunal's records by free text — PTAB proceedings/decisions or Federal Circuit opinions.

Routes to the right tribunal by ``forum``. Only the two free-text
searches fold here; for UPC decisions or Federal Circuit
patent-opinions-by-date use the dedicated ``search_upc_decisions`` /
``search_cafc_patent_opinions``. For one record by identifier use
``get_litigation``.

Related tools: get_litigation, search_upc_decisions,
search_cafc_patent_opinions.

forum.description: Which tribunal's free-text index to search. 'ptab' = USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board records (AIA trials, ex parte appeals, pre-AIA interferences). 'cafc' = U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit opinions and orders. For UPC decisions or CAFC patent-only-by-date use the dedicated structured-filter tools.

full.description: False (default) = lean stub per hit (small). True = full record per hit (large; prefer get_litigation for a single record).

ptab_type.description: forum='ptab' only: which PTAB record kind to search. 'proceeding' = AIA trials (IPR/PGR/CBM/DER); 'trial_decision'/'trial_document' = filings in those trials; 'appeal_decision' = ex parte appeals; 'interference_decision' = pre-AIA interferences.

patent_only.description: forum='cafc' only: case-name heuristic; can miss patent cases.

offset.description: Number of source records to skip (PTAB or CAFC).

next_cursor.description: Continuation from the previous response; overrides offset and limit. Keep forum, query, ptab_type, and patent_only unchanged.

name: search_office_actions
description:
Search USPTO office-action data (rejections, citations, text, or enriched citations).

All four result types share the same Lucene ``criteria`` surface but
accept different field names — see the ``criteria`` description for
the valid fields per type. Returns lean stubs by default; pass
``full=True`` for the full Solr record per hit.

For a single office action's full text by document identifier, use
``get_office_action`` instead.

Related tools: get_office_action, search_applications, list_file_history,
get_application.

criteria.description: Lucene query. Valid fields depend on result_type:   rejections → patentApplicationNumber, hasRej101, hasRej102, hasRej103, hasRej112, hasRejDP, legalSectionCode, nationalClass, groupArtUnitNumber, submissionDate, aliceIndicator, allowedClaimIndicator.   citations → patentApplicationNumber, referenceIdentifier, parsedReferenceIdentifier, legalSectionCode, examinerCitedReferenceIndicator, applicantCitedExaminerReferenceIndicator, groupArtUnitNumber, techCenter.   text → patentApplicationNumber, inventionTitle, submissionDate, legacyDocumentCodeIdentifier (CTNF/CTFR/NOA/…), groupArtUnitNumber, patentNumber, applicationTypeCategory.   enriched_citations → patentApplicationNumber, citedDocumentIdentifier, publicationNumber, inventorNameText, countryCode, kindCode, officeActionCategory, citationCategoryCode, officeActionDate, examinerCitedReferenceIndicator, nplIndicator, groupArtUnitNumber.

result_type.description: What to search: 'rejections' (per-claim rejection records with 101/102/103/112/DP indicators plus Alice/Bilski/Mayo/Myriad flags), 'citations' (prior-art references cited with examiner/applicant indicators), 'text' (full office-action body text with structured sections), or 'enriched_citations' (citations with inventor names, country/kind codes, and passage locations).

full.description: When False (the default), each hit is a lean stub (~8 scalars: identifier, application number, document code, mail date, rejection types or reference id, art unit, etc.). When True, each hit is the full Solr record — for 'text', this includes the full bodyText and structured sections (large).

name: search_patent_assignments
description:
Search USPTO patent assignment recordations by assignee, assignor, conveyance, or patent identifier.

Returns recordations with reel/frame, conveyance type, assignors,
assignees, correspondent, and affected properties. Lean by default
(§5.5); use ``full=True`` for the upstream record per hit. To pull
assignments for a specific application, use ``get_patent_assignment``;
for the underlying prosecution context, use ``get_application`` or
``get_patent``.

Related tools: get_patent_assignment, get_application, get_patent.

by.description: What kind of value `query` is. One of: assignee, assignor, correspondent, application_number, patent_number, publication_number, reel_frame, international_registration_number, pct_number.

exact.description: True for exact match, False (default) for contains match. Ignored for number axes, where USPTO accepts either.

executed_after.description: Narrow to recordations whose assignor execution date is on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Without ``executed_before`` the range runs through today. Note: only assignor execution date is honored by USPTO; recordation, mail, and receipt date filters are ignored.

executed_before.description: Narrow to recordations whose assignor execution date is on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Without ``executed_after`` the range starts at 1980-01-01, the start of USPTO's assignment records.

conveyance.description: Contains-match against conveyance text (e.g. 'ASSIGNMENT', 'SECURITY', 'CHANGE OF NAME').

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. None (default) fetches everything matching, capped at USPTO's ~10,000 for very-broad queries.

full.description: When False (the default), each hit is a lean stub: reel/frame, conveyance, first assignor, first assignee, execution date, number of properties, plus the lead property's application/patent/publication number. When True, every hit is the full Assignment Center record (all assignors, correspondent, etc.). Note: USPTO's July 2026 Assignment Center update stopped returning per-hit properties from search, so the property-derived fields are currently always null/empty.

name: search_patents
title: Search Patents (US / EP / WO / KR)
description:
Search patents by jurisdiction using clean public sources (no Google).

Routes to the right official source by ``jurisdiction``:
US → USPTO PPUBS full text; EP/WO → EPO OPS CQL; KR → KIPRIS.
Returns a §5.9 ``ListEnvelope`` of hits (lean stubs by default).

Full-text search of CN and JP body text has no clean public source. To
look at a known CN/JP publication, pass its number to ``get_patent``.

Related tools: get_patent, resolve_patent_number.

query.description: Search query. For US (jurisdiction='us') this is PPUBS full-text syntax (Boolean + field codes like CLM/SPEC/AB/TTL). For EP/WO (jurisdiction='ep_wo') this is EPO CQL (e.g. 'ta=CRISPR and pa=Broad'). For KR (jurisdiction='kr') this is KIPRIS free text.

jurisdiction.description: Which clean source to search. 'us' = USPTO Public Search (PPUBS) full text (claims + specification + abstract). 'ep_wo' = EPO OPS worldwide CQL search (best for EP/WO; biblio across many offices). 'kr' = KIPO KIPRIS (requires the deployment to carry a KIPRIS key). Note: CN and JP full-text search have no clean public source — retrieve a known CN/JP number via get_patent instead.

limit.description: Maximum results to return (1-20 for US PPUBS).

full.description: False (default) = lean stub per hit. True = full upstream row (large; prefer get_patent for one record).

name: search_trademark_assignments
description:
Search USPTO trademark assignment recordations by assignee, assignor, or mark identifier.

Returns recordations with reel/frame, assignors, assignees, and
affected trademark properties. Lean by default (§5.5); use
``full=True`` for the upstream record per hit. No auth required.
For the underlying register data, use ``get_trademark`` (full record)
or ``get_trademark_status`` (current TSDR status).

Related tools: get_trademark, get_trademark_status, search_trademarks.

by.description: What kind of value `query` is. One of: assignee, assignor, serial_number, registration_number, reel_frame.

limit.description: Maximum records to return per request (max 1000).

full.description: When False (the default), each hit is a lean stub: reel/frame, first assignor, first assignee, execution date, number of properties, plus the lead property's serial/registration number and mark text. When True, every hit is the full Trademark Assignment Center record (all properties, all assignors, correspondent, domestic representative, etc.).

name: search_trademarks
description:
Search USPTO trademarks by wordmark, owner, or goods/services (TESS).

Returns lean stubs by default. Use ``get_trademark`` for a full record or
current status by serial/registration number. For assignment recordations
(reel/frame, assignor/assignee chains) use ``search_trademark_assignments``.

Related tools: get_trademark, search_trademark_assignments.

query.description: Search query — a wordmark, owner name, or goods/services description.

search_by.description: Which field to search. 'wordmark' (default) — trademark text; 'owner' — registrant name; 'goods_services' — goods/services description.

paginate_all.description: When true, auto-paginates through all matching results (wordmark/owner only). Ignored for goods_services.

max_results.description: Cap on total results when paginate_all=True.

full.description: False (default) = lean stub per hit (serial, wordmark, owner, status, dates, registration number). True = full TESS record per hit (large; prefer get_trademark for one).

name: search_upc_decisions
description:
Search Unified Patent Court (UPC) decisions and orders by court, division, or language.

Returns a page of decisions with canonical case IDs (``UPC_CFI_<n>/<yyyy>``,
``UPC_CoA_<n>/<yyyy>``, or ``ACT_<n>/<yyyy>``), court, type of action,
parties, and direct URLs to the PDF/A document(s). Lean stubs by default;
pass ``full=True`` for the upstream-shaped row. Pagination via the
``page`` arg; ``more_available`` reflects ``total_pages`` from the pager.

Related tools: get_upc_decision, list_upc_divisions, list_upc_languages,
search_upc_statutes.

judgement_type.description: Filter to 'order' or 'decision'; omit for both

court_type.description: Court-type ID: '1' = Court of Appeal, '2' = Central CFI, '3' = Local CFI, '4' = Regional CFI. Omit for all.

division.description: Specific division ID — use list_upc_divisions to discover.

proceedings_lang.description: Procedural-language ID — use list_upc_languages to discover.

full.description: When False (default), each hit is a lean stub: case_id, court, type_of_action, parties, detail_url, primary_pdf_url. When True, every hit carries the upstream row (with full pdf_urls list and raw_references) — prefer ``get_upc_decision`` for one record.

name: search_upc_statutes
description:
Search the Unified Patent Court (UPC) statutes corpus (UPCA, RoP, Fees, CoC).

Returns ranked snippets with ``<mark>...</mark>`` highlights around
matched terms. Use this for citation lookups like ``"Article 33"``
or topical searches like ``"opt-out withdrawal"``. Once you've
located a provision, call ``get_upc_section`` to fetch the full
instrument text.

Related tools: get_upc_section, list_upc_instruments.

query.description: Search query against the UPC statutes corpus.

instrument.description: Optional instrument key — 'upca', 'rop', 'fees', or 'coc'. Use 'statute' as an alias for the UPCA Annex I portion. Omit to search across all instruments.

name: search_uspto
description:
Search USPTO records — application metadata, full-text publications, or petition decisions.

Routes to the right USPTO index by ``dataset``. NOTE: 'applications'
searches metadata only; for claim/specification text use
'publications'. For one record by identifier use ``get_uspto``; for
prosecution documents use ``get_file_history``; for office actions or
assignments use the dedicated ``search_office_actions`` /
``search_patent_assignments``.

Related tools: get_uspto, get_file_history, search_office_actions, search_patent_assignments.

dataset.description: Which USPTO index to search. 'applications' = ODP application metadata (title, CPC, dates, status — NOT claim/spec text). 'publications' = Public Search (PPUBS) full text (claims, specification, abstract). 'petitions' = decided petition records.

query.description: Search query. Applications/petitions: Lucene over metadata fields. Publications: PPUBS syntax with field codes (CLM/SPEC/AB/TTL/IN/AS). Example (applications): 'applicationMetaData.inventionTitle:"neural"'. Example (publications): '"machine learning" AND neural.CLM.'

limit.description: Maximum results to return (1-20 for publications).

offset.description: Result offset for pagination. Applies to applications and petitions; PPUBS publications paginate by limit only (offset ignored).

full.description: False (default) = lean stub per hit (small). True = full record per hit (large; prefer get_uspto for a single record).

name: search_wipo_lex_legislation
description:
Search WIPO Lex (global IP legislation database) for statutes across ~200 jurisdictions.

Filters AND together. Returns a lean stub per hit by default
(``legislation_id``, ``title``, ``url``); pass ``full=True`` for the
upstream row shape. Use ``get_wipo_lex_legislation`` with a hit's
``legislation_id`` to pull the jurisdiction, summary line, and
downloadable PDF/DOC attachments.

Examples:
  * Canadian patent law: country_codes=["CA"], subject_matter=[1]
  * Trade secrets statutes globally: subject_matter=[9]
  * UK IP enforcement: country_codes=["GB"], subject_matter=[12]

Related tools: get_wipo_lex_legislation.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes or regional org codes. Examples: ['CA', 'US'], ['EU'].

type_of_text.description: TypeOfText codes: 205=Main IP Laws, 207=Implementing Rules, 210=IP-related Laws, 213=Framework Laws, 214=Other, 215=National IP Strategy.

full.description: When False (the default), each hit is a lean stub: legislation_id, title, url. When True, returns the upstream row shape unchanged.
